title: Ecology federal permits record: Duthie PRF (Aquatics 143126)

rows.label: What the project is
rows.value: The applicant proposes to construct a new pier/ramp/float (PRF) structure within Eastsound on Orcas Island. The proposed pier would be a fully grated 4-foot by 40-foot aluminum pier supported by two, 12- inch galvanized steel pier piles and a 6-foot by 3-foot by 2-foot concrete shore mount. The proposed ramp would be fully grated aluminum and measure 4-foot by 44-foot while the proposed float would be 8-foot by 30-foot fully grated with a 6-foot by 10-foot ramp landing float supported by four galvanized steel float piles. Most of the proposed dock would be installed below MHW with the exception of 17 feet of pier installed above MHW.
